claims: The Terraform test still expects the old Slack title: `alerts/rules/peg-rule-definitions.tftest.hcl:68-69` still requires the title to contain `$alert.Annotations.summary` and `$alert.Annotations.resolved_summary`, but `peg-message-templates.tf:14` now makes the title just an icon, so `terraform test` will fail in the required `ci` check (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:874-879`); it also contradicts the new check in `scripts/alerts/alert-rules-lint.test.mjs:1257-1269`, so the two tests can't both pass
Stale doc: `docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:118-119` still says "Slack titles use the severity icon plus that summary"

Wrong wording for failures on rules with no price source (`peg-alert-events.ts:230-242`): `pegAlertSourceName("")` returns "Price source", so rules with `source = ""` show "Grafana could not evaluate the Price source Peg rule"; both recovery messages (lines 241-242) have the same problem

After an Error, a real alert loses its pairing (`peg-alert-events.ts:109-110`, `cycleKey` at 320-321): Error → Alerting is classified as `error-recovered-alerting`, which closes the error entry but never starts an alert entry, so the later clear shows as a standalone "resolved" entry with no "lasted …" duration and the alert's cause text never appears
Older problem: Alerting → Error → Normal still leaves the alert looking active until it ages out of the 7-day window, because the new Error → Normal row only closes the error entry

judge_reasoning.3830366234: Must-fix #1 says the tftest.hcl lines 68-69 still require summary/resolved_summary in the now icon-only title, which fails the required ci.yml Terraform job.
judge_reasoning.3830366243: The 'Stale doc' bullet says docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:118-119 still describes the title as icon plus summary and needs updating.
judge_reasoning.3830366247: The review never mentions recoveries through Pending, or that errorStateHistoryUrl omits Pending transitions.
judge_reasoning.3830366547: The 'Related, older problem' section says Alerting → Error → Normal leaves the alert looking active because the Error → Normal row only closes the error entry.
judge_reasoning.3830366556: No mention of Error → Pending leaving an orphaned error cycle or a stuck 'monitoring failed' row.
judge_reasoning.3830371307: The review does not discuss fragile marker-index extraction or unscoped link checks in the lint test.
judge_reasoning.3830371325: The defect text is truncated but points at error-recovered-alerting and cycle pairing. Finding #3 says error-recovered-alerting closes the error entry but never opens an alert entry, so the later clear goes unpaired.
judge_reasoning.3830416461: Finding #2 says source-less rules get labeled 'Price source' via pegAlertSourceName("") in both the failure and recovery rows.

1.why: peg-rule-definitions.tftest.hcl:68-69 still requires $alert.Annotations.summary/resolved_summary in the title, but the new icon-only title no longer has them; this is the known 'Update the stale Terraform title assertion' defect

2.why: docs/notes/peg-monitoring.md:118-119 does still say 'Slack titles use the severity icon plus that summary'; this is the known 'Keep the Peg runbook aligned with the new title' defect

3.why: peg-alert-copy.ts:49 returns 'Price source' for an empty source, and evaluationCause puts that into the failure and recovery leads; this is the known 'Label source-less evaluation failures by rule' defect

4.why: transitionKind maps Error→Alerting to error-recovered-alerting, and cycleKey puts it under the 'error' key, so it only closes the error entry; the later Alerting→Normal clear finds no open or observed alert entry and ends up in unpairedCleared, shown as a standalone resolved entry with no 'lasted' duration and no raise cause

5.why: Alerting opens the 'alert' key and Error→Normal (error-recovered) only closes the 'error' key, so the alert stays open at the end of pairStateTransitions; this is the known 'Error recovery leaves breach active' (line 352) defect
